alphaSubsetDefinition: If available, exact source G scalar; level 0 alpha>=128, lower levels unquantized footprint mean>=127.5. This is a source-mask proxy, not a claim about driver-generated alpha mips or actual camera visibility.
metricDefinition: Codec-only compares decoded HALF to supplied HALF. Including mip rounding compares decoded HALF to the unquantized Float64 area-mean reference (base: exact original HALF). Angles use atan2(cross magnitude,dot) after RGB*2-1 and common normalScale(1,-1); no texture is normalized or changed.
